COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
BA 1st No.554 of 2026
“Sonu Vs. State of Uttarakhand”
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for the 
Applicant.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned DAG with Mr. Pramod Tewari, 
learned AGA with Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
3. In the High Court of Uttarakhand, the present case arises 
from Bail Application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya 
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking regular bail for the 
Applicant – Sonu, who has been accused in FIR No.550 of 2025,
dated 02.10.2025 under Section 108 of BNS, at Police Station
Pathri, District Haridwar. 
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Applicant 
submits for consideration of the bail that the present matter relates 
to abetment to suicide, which is not well founded as the deceased 
and the Applicant were in relationship, and the deceased consumed 
poison and committed suicide in her matrimonial house does not 
relate to any action, which may be associated with abetment, 
which caused her to commit suicide.
5. Learned State Counsel prays for and is granted two weeks’ 
time to file counter affidavit.
6. List this matter on 27.04.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
 09.04.2026
Nitesh/

3. The present matter relates to a case of abetment to suicide, 
wherein the main allegation against the Applicant is that the 
deceased was in a love relationship with the Applicant and allegedly 
committed suicide on account of the Applicant. The death of the 
deceased is stated to have occurred by consumption of poison.
4. Counter affidavit has not yet been filed.
5. Learned State Counsel is directed to file the counter affidavit 
along with the viscera report and post-mortem report.
6. List this case on 07.05.2026.
